data.name: Faishal
data.gender_notes: Faishal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who achieves victory or conquers. The name Faishal carries the meaning “Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Faishal usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who has conquered their inner demons and achieved spiritual victory
data.etymology: Faishal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faishal total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: فيصل
in_arabic.meaning: القاضي أو الحاكم الذي يفصل بين الناس بالعدل
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فيصل مشتق من الفصل، يعني القاضي أو الحاكم الذي يفصل بين الناس بالعدل والحق. هذا الاسم يدل على الحكمة والعدالة، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَيَقْضِيَ الْحُكَمَاءُ بِالْعَدْلِ'. يعتبر اسم فيصل من الأسماء ذات الأهمية الكبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرتبط بالعدالة والإنصاف.

in_urdu.name: فیصل
in_urdu.long_meaning: فیصل نام کا مطلب ہے منصف یا حاکم جو لوگوں کے درمیان انصاف سے فیصلہ کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے 'فصل' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے الگ کرنا یا جدا کرنا۔ اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام انصاف اور حق کے ساتھ جڑا ہوا ہے، اور اکثر انبیاء اور حكماء کے ساتھ وابستہ ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے، یہ نام اہم مذہبی اور ثقافتی اہمیت کا حامل ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फ़ैसल
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़ैसल नाम का अर्थ है न्याय करने वाला या निष्पक्ष शासक। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के 'फ़सल' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है अलग करना या निर्णय लेना। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम न्याय और सच्चाई के साथ जुड़ा हुआ है, और अक्सर बुद्धिमान और न्यायप्रिय नेताओं के साथ जुड़ा होता है।

in_pashto.name: فیصل
in_pashto.long_meaning: فیصل نوم دى مطلب دى چې منصف یا د عدلي قاضي دى، چى د خلکو تر منځ د انصاف سره فيصله کوي. دا نوم د عربي ژبې د 'فصل' څخه اخستل شوى دى، چى دى مطلب يې جلا کول يا توپير کول دى. د افغان او پښتون دود په کې، دا نوم د انصاف او حق سره تړلى دى، او ډیری وختونه د حکمت او دانایی سره مل وي.

in_english.name: Faishal
in_english.meaning: Judge, ruler, or decider, one who brings justice
in_english.long_meaning: The name Faishal originates from the Arabic root 'fasl', meaning to separate, decide, or judge. In Islamic tradition, Faishal signifies a just ruler or arbitrator who makes fair decisions. Historically, this name has been associated with wise leaders and judges known for their impartiality and wisdom. The name carries significant spiritual meaning, reflecting qualities of justice, fairness, and good governance. Across Muslim cultures, Faishal remains a popular name symbolizing integrity and leadership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Faishal can be traced back to the Arabic language where fai'shal literally means "one who conquers" or "a conqueror." This name has been highly regarded in Islamic history and culture, especially during times of war and conquest. Muslim leaders with the name Faishal have been revered for their bravery, leadership, and strategic abilities on the battlefield. Today, the name is often given to boys as a sign of strength and ambition, reflecting the rich cultural heritage of Islamic conquest and historical achievements.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Faishal holds a deeper meaning beyond worldly conquests and victories. It represents the struggle to conquer the self and achieve inner peace and enlightenment. Muslims believe that the ultimate conquest is to submit oneself to Allah and follow His guidance in every aspect of life. Thus, the name Faishal can be a constant reminder for the bearer to strive towards self-improvement, spiritual growth, and an unwavering attachment to Allah. Additionally, the name can serve as a source of inspiration to others, encouraging them to embark on their own journey of self-discovery and inner victory.

historical_references.reference: The name Faishal is believed to have originated from the Islamic prophet Al-Farqad ibn Al-Jadil, who was a prominent companion of Prophet Muhammad and is known for his bravery and generosity. He was a chief of the Khazraj tribe in Medina and played a significant role in the Battle of Badr and the Treaty of Hudaybiyah.

Another reference to the name Faishal can be found in the context of the Sultanate of Malacca (1402-1511 AD), where Faishal was the name of a Malay ruler who ruled over the city of Malacca in the late 15th century. He is best known for his efforts in expanding the city's trade and diplomacy with neighboring kingdoms, and for his patronage of Islamic scholars and architects, leading to the construction of several significant mosques and madrasas in Malacca.
